title: Philippines presents itself in Madrid as a strategic partner for the Spanish company in infrastructure, energy and digital services

blocks.text: The Independence Headquarters of the Madrid Chamber of Commerce has hosted the conference “Business Connection: Spain and the Philippines”, a strategic meeting organized by the chamber entity together with the Embassy of the Republic of the Philippines in Spain, its Commercial Office (PTIC-Madrid) and the Philippine technology employers’ association IBPAP. The session highlighted the business and investment opportunities in one of the most dynamic economies in Southeast Asia, a market of more than 117 million inhabitants that is growing at more than 5% per year and has just been classified by the World Bank as an upper-middle-income economy.
